title: Imidazolium versus phenylalaninium hybrid salts: supramolecular control of electronic, nonlinear optical and bioactive properties
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,10230-10242
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09394E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Sandra Walha, Rageh K. Hussein, Thierry Roisnel, Ali Ben Ahmed
Two non-centrosymmetric amino-acid hybrid salts were synthesized to probe halide effects. The iodide shows stronger charge transfer, a smaller band gap, and 3× higher hyperpolarizability from N–H···I interactions, with enhanced bioactivity.
